text: Meet EchoFlow. Teach it once, then just ask.
We show it once: search for garlic bread, add it, and open the cart.
One demonstration, saved as a lesson. Now, the exact same request.
It replays the lesson by itself, and stops at payment. Paying is always up to you.
Now different words, for the same task.
It understands the new wording on the phone, and sees the garlic bread is already in the cart.
Next, a new item, and a quantity it was never shown.
Two choco lava cakes, from a single garlic bread lesson. It sets the quantity in the cart itself.
Finally, a dish that doesn't exist.
It asks, instead of guessing, and stops without adding anything.
Teach once. Ask any way. Payment stays with you.
